name: @sos-2/task-runner
description: SOS 2.0 Task Runner host (Work Order P12): the plain Node + TypeScript composition root of the autonomy and task runtimes. The composition root is the SINGLE impure boundary (injected clock/beat source/event sinks — the no-ambient-timer discipline following the apps/actions precedent): it assembles the in-memory durable stores, the body broker with reference cloud bodies, the execution fabric, the durable task graph, the P9 action gateway (authority-gated body-lifecycle lease actions), the lease supervisor, the recovery planner, the outage registry with bounded backoff, the cost ledger and the task timeline — everything injected, deterministic and offline. Provider statuses are reported HONESTLY: the in-memory seams are REFERENCE, real endpoints are NOT_YET_CONNECTED (no fabricated liveness).
